question: How should dual-brain route tasks between Claude and GPT models?
claude_position: Route by work style (Fast/Balanced/Full Power) not budget. The real value of GPT routing is independence — different training pipeline catches different blind spots, not 'GPT is better at X'.
gpt_position: Agree on work styles over budget. Add: route by intent, cost preference, and availability. Default paths must stay fast. Dual-brain should trigger by risk threshold, not be default for everything.
synthesis: Three work styles drive routing policy. Sonnet is default workhorse. Opus for deep single-brain reasoning. GPT for independent challenger/review. Challenger triggers based on risk level per work style, not budget. No fake usage tracking.
